text:
Sara (CS): Quick PSA — BrightScale's account: noticed a spike in 5xx and timeouts during their nightly ingest window (2026-01-12 02:00 UTC). Dumping top failing endpoints so we can assign.

Olivia (Analytics): Pulling the numbers now. 5xx rate jumped from 0.9% -> 4.6% between 01:55-02:10 UTC. Timeouts x3. Top offenders:
- POST /v1/streams/ingest — 54% of 5xx (mostly 502/504)
- POST /v1/generate — 22% (503)
- POST /v1/embeddings — 13% (429 + some 504)
- GET /v1/models/meta — 8% (timeouts)
- GET /health/ping — 3% (slow)

Mike (Eng): was there a deploy around then?

deploy-bot: Deploy "release/ingest-backoff" rolled to prod at 01:48 UTC by ci/cd. No rollbacks.

Mike (Eng): might be related to backpressure changes in ingest. Assigning to me to triage — will check proxy logs + LB metrics. @Anya (Ops) can you pull connection pool stats for the ingest fleet?

Anya (Ops): on it. Pool usage peaked at 96% and backend latency spiked. Attached sample log snippet:

```
[01:58:12] upstream response: 504, req_id=abc123, backend=ingest-12, qlen=37, conn_active=92
```

Mike (Eng): Thanks — initial theory: surge + new backoff led to head-of-line blocking on ingest frontends. I'll open a short-lived canary revert if needed. ETA 45m.

Sara (CS): Customer PM (James) is on standby and flagged renewal check next week, want to keep them calm. @James (BrightScale PM) any impact on their jobs?

James (BrightScale PM): We retried; about ~6% of nightly batches needed manual rerun this morning. Not catastrophic but they flagged ops pain. Appreciate quick fixes.

Olivia (Analytics): Also saw rate-limit alarms for /v1/embeddings — they hit burst quota (429s) starting 02:03 UTC. Recommend short-term bump + rate-limit guidance.

Anya (Ops): Action items:
- Mike — triage ingest backend & proxy configs, follow-up by 02:30 UTC
- Ops — temp bump for embeddings quota and notify CS
- Sara — coordinate customer comms + note for renewal risk doc

Sara (CS): Noted. I'll send a short incident note to BrightScale and attach postmortem once root cause identified. :thumbsup:

Mike (Eng): started root-cause thread: https://redwood.internal/threads/ingest-504-1780212345

James (BrightScale PM): Thanks all. Keep us posted.
